name: Account lost, hacked or family-plan access
model_suggested_name: Account access lost, hacked, or blocked
model_description: Customers report being locked out of their accounts, having accounts hacked, disabled, or unrecognized, or losing playlists and liked songs after linking or verification failures.

name: Other access problems
model_suggested_name: Liked songs and library fail to load
model_description: Customers report that their liked songs, playlists, or library screens are blank or fail to load, plus general app malfunctions such as logouts, installation failure, and access restrictions.

name: Login, logout and password problems
model_suggested_name: Cannot log in or stay logged in
model_description: Customers cannot log in or sign up with their phone number, password, or account, or get logged out repeatedly, often seeing 'something went wrong' errors.

name: "No internet connection" error blocks access
model_suggested_name: False 'no internet connection' error blocks app
model_description: Customers with working internet see a 'no internet connection' or 'offline' message that prevents them from opening or using the app.

name: Charges, refunds, payments and trials
model_suggested_name: Unexpected charges, billing errors and trial confusion
model_description: Customers report being charged unexpectedly, billed twice, charged on accounts they no longer use, failing payments, or surprised by a free trial ending, with poor help from support.

name: Other billing complaints
model_suggested_name: General frustration with forced payments and restrictions
model_description: Customers feel the app pushes them to pay, restricts free use (shuffle-only playback, no song choice, ads) and generally dislike management's monetization approach.

name: Features locked behind Premium (skips, song choice, playback)
model_suggested_name: Core features locked behind Premium subscription
model_description: Customers say basic functions such as choosing songs, skipping, and playlist use require Premium, and some who paid still find features not working.

name: Price level and price increases
model_suggested_name: Subscription price too high and recently raised
model_description: Customers find the Premium subscription and plans too expensive for the value received, and object to price increases without added benefits.

name: Songs, artists or podcasts unavailable
model_suggested_name: Songs and artists missing or unavailable
model_description: Customers report that specific songs, artists or podcasts they want are missing, removed or marked not available, sometimes behind a premium paywall.

name: Other catalog complaints
model_suggested_name: Playback changes and unwanted songs in catalog
model_description: Customers complain that the app plays songs they did not choose, will not play their preferred music after updates, or shows fewer songs than expected.

name: Lyrics missing or broken
model_suggested_name: Lyrics not showing or failing to load
model_description: Customers report that song lyrics do not appear, fail to load, or have been removed from the app.

name: Recommendations, repeats and smart features
model_suggested_name: Repetitive or poor song recommendations and algorithm
model_description: Customers say recommendations, Discover Weekly and autoplay keep repeating the same music or push unwanted songs, and they cannot find new music.

name: Search doesn't find content
model_suggested_name: Search returns playlists or no songs
model_description: Customers report that search fails to find the songs or artists they want, returns playlists instead of tracks, or has lost previous search features.

name: Downloads fail or won't start
model_suggested_name: Downloads fail or won't start
model_description: Customers report that tracks, playlists, or podcasts cannot be downloaded or get stuck partway through downloading.

name: Other download problems
model_suggested_name: Playlists refuse to download and unstable downloads
model_description: Customers report playlists or downloaded songs that won't download, glitch, change unexpectedly, or fail to cache, along with general complaints about the app's music experience.

name: Downloads disappear or must be re-downloaded
model_suggested_name: Downloaded music and playlists disappear
model_description: Customers report that downloaded songs, playlists, or podcasts vanish or get deleted and must be downloaded again.

name: Offline mode not working
model_suggested_name: Offline playback of downloads fails
model_description: Customers report that downloaded music will not play offline or the app incorrectly shows it is offline without a connection.

name: SD card and storage location problems
model_suggested_name: Downloads stuck on internal storage, no SD card option
model_description: Customers report that downloads cannot be moved to or kept on an SD card, with settings reverting to internal storage and storage access problems.

name: Boycott / political protest with a complaint or departure
model_suggested_name: Boycott over Quran burning and Swedish origin
model_description: Users are boycotting or uninstalling Spotify in protest over the Quran burning in Sweden and the app's Swedish origin, rather than over any product fault.

name: General dissatisfaction, no specific product issue
model_suggested_name: Vague general dissatisfaction with no specific cause
model_description: Users express broad negative sentiment about the app without naming any concrete product problem.

name: Audio quality and volume
model_suggested_name: Poor audio quality and uneven volume
model_description: Customers report low, harsh, or inconsistent sound quality and volume fluctuations, and some note the lack of lossless audio compared to competitors.

name: Connection, Bluetooth, car and devices
model_suggested_name: Playback drops and wrong connectivity with car and Bluetooth
model_description: Customers report false no-internet errors, sound dropping on car or Bluetooth speakers, slow loading, and unwanted autoplay when devices connect.

name: App crashes / won't open
model_suggested_name: App crashes, closes, or fails to open
model_description: The app crashes, closes unexpectedly, or refuses to open or start playing after updates.

name: Other playback problems (bugs, not working)
model_suggested_name: Wrong songs play instead of selected ones
model_description: Customers report that tapping a song or playlist plays different tracks, autoplay or shuffle takes over, or playlists and loops behave incorrectly.

name: Lag, slowness, battery and loading
model_suggested_name: Slow loading, buffering, and battery drain
model_description: The app takes too long to load songs or playlists, buffers constantly, and drains the battery.

name: Music stops, pauses or cuts out
model_suggested_name: Music pauses, stops, or cuts out mid-song
model_description: Playback randomly pauses, stops mid-song, or gets stuck and requires restarting the app.

name: Songs won't play / app not working / bugs
model_suggested_name: Songs won't play or play the wrong track
model_description: Selected songs or playlists fail to play, pause early, or are replaced by other suggested or random tracks.

name: Customer support contact and response
model_suggested_name: Unresponsive or poor customer support service
model_description: Customers report that Spotify customer support is bad, unresponsive, or fails to reply to their tickets or account problems.

name: Ad frequency, length and loudness
model_suggested_name: Excessive ad frequency and loudness
model_description: Users report too many ads, including an ad after nearly every song, and ads that feel intrusive or louder than the music.

name: Other usability complaints
model_suggested_name: Skip limits, autoplay and missing playback controls
model_description: Users complain about limited skips, unwanted autoplay, inability to pick or go back to songs, and pushy premium prompts.

name: Playlist, queue and library management
model_suggested_name: Playlist, queue and liked songs malfunctions
model_description: Users report playlist edits reverting, queued songs disappearing, liked songs not loading, and difficulty adding songs to playlists.

name: New update / redesign / navigation and layout
model_suggested_name: Disruptive app updates removing core features
model_description: Users say recent updates changed the layout and removed basic functions such as repeat, rewind, and liking songs.

name: Forced shuffle / can't choose song order
model_suggested_name: Forced shuffle and lost song-order control
model_description: Users are stuck on shuffle, cannot turn it off or choose specific songs and timestamps, and lack previous/next controls.
